name: Graphite
author: sluhtie
description: A clean, minimal and modern Steam. Neutral graphite surfaces, one editable accent color and quiet typography across the library, menus, settings, friends and the Store & Community pages. New in 2.0: an app layout with an icon rail, one search for library and store, a side navigation and a friends dock.

Font.description: Interface font. Inter is loaded from Google Fonts, System uses Segoe UI on Windows.

Corners.description: Corner style of cards, buttons and the content panel.

Header.description: Clean and Classic: Single row merges the menu bar and the Store / Library / Community tabs into one compact row. No effect with Graphite 2.0, which has its own title bar.

Navigation.description: Graphite 2.0 (default): an app layout with an icon rail on the left, one search in the title bar, a side navigation for the store and community and a friends dock. Clean: one navigation row; View / Friends / Games / Help fold away behind the Steam logo, the profile tab and the tabs' hover dropdowns are removed, and community pages get their own sub-navigation (incl. your profile, inventory, badges ...). Classic keeps Steam's menus.

Start page.description: Graphite 2.0: what Home shows. Cockpit: your last game, friends online, downloads and recently played. Spotlight: your last game full-bleed. Bento: tiles for game, friends, downloads, playtime and collections. Library: Steam's library home.

Store & community pages.description: Also restyle the Store and Community web pages shown inside Steam. Includes a small local script that recolors Valve's newer React pages (wishlist, calendar, news hub, charts).

Hide URL bar.description: Hide the address bar above store and community pages (the tabs or side navigation and the page navigation already cover it). Works in every layout.

Hide What's New.description: Hide the "What's New" event row on Steam's library home. Applies where that home is shown: Clean, Classic, or Graphite 2.0 with Start page: Library.

Hide Add shelf.description: Hide the "Add shelf" button under the shelves on Steam's library home. Applies where that home is shown: Clean, Classic, or Graphite 2.0 with Start page: Library.

Startup screen.description: Graphite 2.0: show the Graphite logo while the main window loads.
